failures.evidence: api/comment_actions.go editComment takes s.gateComment (the anchored document's writer gate) at line 158 before the input-only refusal 'blocks: requires base_revision' at lines 165-168, so an edit that can never succeed queues behind every writer of the document, takes the gate, and only then answers 400; under a full queue it gets 429 EDIT_QUEUE_FULL, which the agent CLI retries (waitsOut) though no retry can succeed. Real binary (lt3 stack, head build, /legion/scratch/tmp/infra-592-tester/r5-demo.sh, in dispatch://INFRA-592/artifact/infra-592-tester-round4-tar-gz): with an anchored comment's valid edit holding the gate (its row held by psql for 12 s), the invalid edit answered '400 INVALID_COMMENT' after 8.93 s; with no gate held the same request answered in 0.010 s. Red test: packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/api/document_writer_gate_test.go TestACommentEditRefusedForItsInputWaitsOnNoWriterGate (commit 22fcdcdf 'test(dispatch): red test: a comment edit refused for its input waits on no writer gate'): holds the document's writer gate with service.AcquireDocumentWriter and requires the PATCH with blocks and no base_revision to answer 400 within 2 s. `cd packages/envoy && DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://... go test ./internal/dispatch/api/ -run TestACommentEditRefusedForItsInputWaitsOnNoWriterGate -count=1` fails 3 of 3 at the head: 'an edit with blocks and no base_revision is still unanswered 2 s into another writer's hold of the document's gate (1 writers queued), want its 400 at once'. Main's #2463 ran that check before its transaction with no gate to wait on.
